newsitem.title: ITALY: Omnitel in talks with Mannesman over higher stake.
newsitem.headline: Omnitel in talks with Mannesman over higher stake.

text.p: Italian mobile telephone venture Omnitel, in which Olivetti has a 41.3 percent stake, is in talks with Mannesmann which could lead to the German firm upping its Omnitel stake, Omnitel's MD said.

Omnitel Managing Director Silvio Scaglia said negotiations were under way which could result in Mannesmann buying an increased stake in Omnitel Sistemi Radiocellulari, which owns 70 percent of Omnitel Pronto Italia.

Financial daily Il Sole 24 Ore reported on Thursday that Mannesmann was interested in acquiring an eight percent stake in Sistemi Radiocellulari, equivalent to 5.6 percent of Omnitel Pronto Italia, from Olivetti.
The deal would enable Olivetti to retain a controlling stake in the venture, Il Sole said.
Olivetti, which has suffered a sharp deterioration in its financial position in recent months, needs to sell assets in order to reduce debt.
Mannesmann currently holds a relatively small indirect stake in Omnitel Pronto Italia (OPI).
